notes.title: AZT Update Released. Credits to Gold exchange
notes.content:
Commanders!

An update to Affected Zone Tactics has been released. It includes the credits to gold exchange.

CREDITS EXCHANGE

One of the basic principle on which we are developing AZT is the principle of fairness. This means that the invested player efforts and resources must be fairly valued and rewarded. The use of premium equipment is not a privilege, it is the standard. Therefore, we strive to ensure that every player was able to play using the best equipment and ammunition. Previously, we've added ways to make gold through the game, now it's time for new opportunities.

Now you can exchange earned credits for gold. At the moment, this functionality will run in test mode, and we plan to work on it in the future.



To exchange credits for gold we added the menu "Purchase gold", which becomes available after you gain one victory in PVP-arena mode during the day.



Here you can specify how much gold you want to buy (currently the maximum amount is limited to 40 gold/day). The system calculates the cost of purchasing by dynamic rate: first gold will cost 18 credits, and each subsequent gold will be more expensive by 76 credits. This ultimately affects the speed of gold accumulation - you can exchange all gold limit at once, that will be more expensive, or exchange it in parts and save money, but it will take more time.

For example, exchanging every day for 40 gold (60 000 credits), you get 200 gold for 5 days and spent 300 000 credits in total. But exchanging every day for 20 gold (14 800 credits), you get the same 200 gold for 10 days, but they will cost you only 148 000 credits in total.

Have a nice game!

notes.title: Event. Mad Pumpkins Invasion
notes.content:
Commanders!

Tesla Zone HQ received information about the appearance of a lot of pumpkins near important infrastructure objects and cities. Everyone ordered to be extreme caution - some of pumpkins are explosive. Scientists were able to develop a vaccine that could protect soldiers, but we need to get more information about this phenomenon. Therefore, the command announced a special award for delivering pumpkins samples.

HALLOWEEN

From 27 October to 6 November collect pumpkins on the battlefields and exchange them for valuable prizes. During this period, you will be able to find 10 pumpkins on each battle map. Some of them – Ripe Pumpkins – can be collected, but others - Mad Pumpkins - explode you. Where and what pumpkins are located, you should find out empirically. Remember: the more players in the battle, the more Ripe Pumpkins can be collected.



To protect your party from Mad Pumpkins, use the vaccine "Antipumpkin".



Several vaccines have already been sent to your mail, also they can be purchased in the store (the "Actions" section). "Antipumpkin" is used during combat. Just use one vaccine by any fighter to protect the entire squad until the end of the battle.



Harvested Ripe Pumpkins can be exchanged for:

Extra Slot - 200 pumpkins
Premium Subscription for 7 days - 75 pumpkins
Medicines Pack – 40 pumpkins
Stimulators Pack – 20 pumpkins
Grenades Pack – 10 pumpkins
Vaccine «Antipumpkin» – 2 pumpkins

If Ripe Pumpkins is not enough, you can always buy them in the store (the "Actions" section).

Attention! You can exchange Ripe Pumpkins only until 13 November. On November 14 all pumpkins will rot.

PREMIUM "PLUS"

From October 27 to November 1, you can get your hands on the Premium "Plus" Subscription, which provides the following bonuses:



Best bonus
Premium "Plus" allow you to get more profits: +100% XP and +100% Credits.

Gold refund
Every day you can receive 100 free Gold to your account with Premium "Plus". To get the gold, you need only to play one battle during the day.

We wish you a fun Halloween and a nice game!

notes.title: AZT Update Released
notes.content:
An update to Affected Zone Tactics has been released. Included changes:

MEDICINES  BALANCE

We continue to work on the balance of different game aspects. In this update we have made the second phase of balancing the medicines, which is aimed at reducing the efficiency of premium variations of injectors and nanofixators.

Nanofixators

Now "Immortality formula" nanofixator treats 3 limbs. Also the cost of "Azure Dragon" nanofixator has been revised.

Injectors

Now injectors heal injures not at every turn but every 2 turns. Also premium injectors effect was reduced.

SOLO TRAINING



We removed the restriction on the team size in the training mode. Now even one player can make the training in any location. This will allow testing your skills or exploring the battle map at any time without searching partner. If you do not add a player in the opposing team the training will take place against a AI controlled soldier. Just create a training battle, select the map and press "Start".

FIXES

Fixed "Phoenix" injector when it regenerates health only on current turn after the next ingury.
Fixed "Immortality formula" nanofixator when it is not consumed after use.

The update will be applied automatically when you restart Affected Zone Tactics.

Have a nice game!

notes.title: AZT Update Released. Arena
notes.content:
Commanders!

An update to Affected Zone Tactics has been released. It includes important changes to the battle modes, matchmaking, creation of battle groups, and clan wars.

ARENA: PVP AND PVE

After analyzing existing AZT battle modes and matchmaking mechanism, we found it necessary to rethink them. In order to simplify the search of opponents and the creation of battle groups, we decided to combine all the players in the overall PvP Arena, which combines standard battles and clan wars. We also moved the battles with virtual opponents in single PvE mode.

PvP Arena mode works similarly to the usual balanced search, but now the options for the creation of battle groups and matchmaking expanded. You can create battle groups with clan members, clan reserve mercenaries, players from another clan (if they are not registered in the Clan Wars) or with the free players.

PvE Arena mode allows players to fight only with virtual opponents. Later the story missions and agent assignments will be added in this mode.



CREATION OF BATTLE GROUPS AND MATCHMAKING

Group search is now located in the top menu. For PvE Arena we left the usual request list, where you can find a mate. For PvP mode group search and creation was founded on the basis of clan battle groups. So now, any battle groups can be joined at one arena - clan groups or common groups, involved in Clan Wars or not.

Clan Wars rules including rates and trophies are applied to all the battles on PVP arena. If the group is involved in Clan Wars, the fight will take place as a normal clan battle for her. For a group not involved in Clan Wars it will be a standard battle, but with the bet.



CLAN WARS

New features in creation of battle groups and matchmaking require some changes to the Clan Wars. Trophies and the generated currencies have been recalculated. Also we removed battle fees and a fixed winning reward.

Leagues are now separated from the rank - you can create battle group of any rank within your league. At the same time Glory Points are defined at the lower league or rank. For example, if the clan creates a 2nd rank group in 5th league, Glory Points are awarded on 2th league. Received currency is determined by rank.



Have a nice game!

notes.title: AZT Update Released
notes.content:
An update to Affected Zone Tactics has been released. Included changes:

MEDICINES  BALANCE

Watching for the effectiveness of medicines in the battle, we came to the conclusion that common and premium variations should be more balanced and should have a smaller effect on survivability. Medicine was extremely effective, allowing you to quickly heal wounds and withstand powerful attacks for a long time. This had a negative impact on the feelings of the battle and its duration.

Stimulants
We decided to remove the side effects of common stimulants, now they provide only useful effects. This will help to make them more popular and competitive.

Nanofixators
Now medicines heal limbs not at once but one limb every 2 turns.

Injectors
Injectors have also been revised. As a result their parameters have become more balanced.

NEW MAP: DRONES BASE

This map invites you to a factory for the production and servicing of combat drones for corporations. Base area has a very good guard on the perimeter, which is not surprising - there is some factories and fortified bunkers, where high-tech weapons are stored. Some mercenaries are ready pay a lot to get a couple of these drones in its arsenal.

Click to zoom

FIXES:

Fixed Commander XP receiving.
Fixed joining battle with overdrive.
Fixed user maps.
 
The update will be applied automatically when you restart Affected Zone Tactics.

Have a nice game!

SHOTGUN BALANCE

In previous updates, we improved automatic weapons and grenades, now it’s time for the shotguns to be improved. As for now, Heavy Infantry Shotguns aren’t very efficient, as they still function with the old mechanics. We’ve changed the algorithm for successful attacks and damage completely.

The main difference is that each shot consists of 20 pellets, the equivalent of the number of fragments or bullets of the other weapons. notes.title: AZT Update. Clan Wars. Episode III
notes.content:
Clan Wars continue to develop and offer new features for commanders. Today we released an update for Affected Zone Tactics. It adds a new method for forming a battle groups with additional mercenaries - Clan reserve.

CLAN RESERVE

If you have free mercenaries, you can send them to the Clan reserve. Clan members will be able to use these soldiers in the clan battle group and control them as own mercenaries. This is beneficial for all: you and clan members will receive Glory points, and your soldiers will gain experience and credits in the battles. In short, you pass your mercenaries to clan members for a while.



Mercenaries should be fully equipped and ready for battle. After the battle, equipment replenished automatically according to the current template. To add reserve soldiers to the battle group, you need to move the matching mercenaries from the reserve list. You can withdraw the mercenaries from the reserve at any time, if they are not in a battle group or in the battle.



Clan reserve allows increasing the number of battle groups, which will increase the clan income. Many clans have low-level players who could not participate in Clan Wars because of the lack of the required number of soldiers or equipment. Now there are options to them - just send a free mercenaries Clan reserve and create new combat groups.

The next stage of Clan Wars development is to involve non-clan players. This will allow clans to gain extra points, and allow any player to try their hand at PvP and earn additional income.

DIRECT CONTROL

The long-awaited possibility for direct control of allied soldiers in the Clan wars became available. In addition to control the reserve mercenaries, it will be useful in many other cases: when a clan member could not appear at the appointed time or disconnected. You just take his soldiers under control and continue to fight.

Moreover, direct control gives a completely new gaming experience when the entire battle group with 8 soldiers can be under the control of a single player!

We wish you a pleasant game!

notes.title: AZT Update. Damage system
notes.content:
Commanders!

Today comes the update of Affected Zone Tactics, in which become available the new damage system and some over changes in the gameplay.

DAMAGE SYSTEM

Shooting system and calculation of damage has been largely rethought. The main purpose of the changes is to reduce the spread of damage and decrease the frequency of misses. Getting and infliction of damage will become more predictable. Critical hits in the head will be reduced to a minimum.

Bullet shooting



Now every bullet in burst shooting counts and it has its own hit chance and damage. Thus the resulting damage depends on how many bullets hits any body parts. In the same time miss chance becomes very small.

Explosions



Damage from explosions is calculated in a new way too. Now any explosion has a 10 parts, which separately cause the damage to different body parts. This allows to spreading the damage more evenly and also makes shooting more predictable.

ARMOR DURABILITY

New damage system required changes in the system of armor durability. Before the update armor durability reduced by 10% of the absorbed damage regardless of the type of weapons, but now there are various modifiers for some weapon types (automatic rifles and machineguns).

SOLDIER DAMAGE INDICATOR

Changed the color indication of mercenaries damage in battle. Now it has a smoother gradation of colors that allows you to assess the body damages more precisely - from yellow (minor damage) to red (critical damage).

Have a nice game!

notes.title: AZT Update. Command Center
notes.content:
Commanders!

An update to Affected Zone Tactics has been released. It includes a lot of changes and bug fixes.

COMMAND CENTER
 
Meet the new barracks! Construction of new command center was completed in Tesla Zone, and your mercenaries already can move to a new location.
 

 
There are two design options - basic and premium for owners of premium account.
 
CHANGES

Changed balanced search algorithm. Matchmaking is now easier and battle awaiting time is reduced.
Added general chat tab in battle interface.
Added medicines types (effect) indicators on abilities panel.
Now "Auto" move mode is set by default in the battle, it does not require manual switching between different modes.
Removed information about using medication on allies from their description.
Added option to select the language in the Steam game properties. Now client automatically sets the proper localization.

FIXES

Fixed matchmaking in balanced search.
Fixed grenade explosion in the incorrect cell at a miss.
Fixed M18 Claymore module of 9 rank sapper set. Now you can learn and use M18 Claymore mines.
Fixed covers and spawn zones on some maps.

Have a nice game!
